$description: SigmaTap design tokens, W3C DTCG format, Tokens Studio compatible. Derived from app/globals.css (as of commit 4116d50) and lib/fonts.ts. Every colour in this codebase is authored in oklch() — Tokens Studio does not parse oklch(), so every colour $value here is hex, converted with the canonical CSS Color 4 OKLab matrices (see docs/handoff/06-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md, 'How the oklch -> hex conversion was verified'). The original oklch() string is preserved verbatim in each token's $description so nothing is lost. Two dark-mode chart colours (chart-4, chart-5) are outside the sRGB gamut and were gamut-clipped during conversion; their $description notes this.

light.$description: app/globals.css :root block, lines 60-113 (as of commit 4116d50). This is the theme applied when next-themes resolves to light (explicit user choice, or system preference under enableSystem).

destructive-foreground.$description: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325) — app/globals.css:76. UNUSUAL: identical value to `destructive` itself in source — this is not a conversion artifact, the two custom properties are literally the same oklch() string. Most consumers (e.g. components/ui/button.tsx's destructive variant) pair `bg-destructive` with `text-white` rather than `text-destructive-foreground`, so this token appears to be effectively unused as a foreground color; flagged rather than silently 'corrected'.

chart-5.$description: oklch(0.769 0.188 70.08) — app/globals.css:85. Also used directly as a brand accent (.text-yellow-500/.bg-yellow-500 utility aliases) — app/globals.css:215-226.

dark.$description: app/globals.css .dark block, lines 116-159 (as of commit 4116d50). Applied when next-themes resolves to dark. This is ALSO the app's default: components/ThemeProvider.tsx wraps next-themes with defaultTheme="dark" and enableSystem (app/layout.tsx:55-60), so a first-time visitor with no stored preference and no OS preference gets dark, and a visitor with an OS light/dark preference gets that preference via prefers-color-scheme (next-themes attribute="class" toggles the `.dark` class on <html>). Cross-checked live: https://sigmatap.vercel.app served `.dark` on <html> with no stored preference set.

chart-4.$description: oklch(0.627 0.265 303.9) — app/globals.css:148. GAMUT-CLIPPED: this oklch value falls outside the sRGB gamut; the hex is the nearest in-gamut approximation from the CSS Color 4 conversion matrices, matching how a browser renders it today (browsers clip out-of-gamut oklch() to sRGB when no wide-gamut display/CSS color() context is used).

chart-5.$description: oklch(0.645 0.246 16.439) — app/globals.css:149. GAMUT-CLIPPED, see chart-4 note.

brand.$description: app/globals.css :root block, lines 103-113. "SigmaTap identity" tokens — NOT redefined inside .dark, so unlike the semantic tokens above these are theme-invariant (the same seal red renders in both light and dark mode). One committed saturated brand colour (the seal) plus warm neutrals tinted toward its hue.

template.$description: components/templates/theme.ts, TEMPLATE_THEMES (lines 47-117, as of commit 4116d50). These 3 profile templates are ALREADY authored in hex in source (no oklch conversion needed) and are independent of the light/dark app-shell theme above — a public profile page is not affected by the visitor's OS/app dark-mode preference. Each template also carries a non-color 'composition' (hero layout, measure, rhythm, rule, heading placement, imagery treatment) documented in 06-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md; composition has no token representation here because DTCG/Tokens Studio has no first-class type for layout-recipe values.

radius.$description: app/globals.css :root, lines 96-99: 'SigmaTap — enforced scales. Exactly three radii, exactly two elevations.' Consumed in component code as rounded-[var(--r-sm|md|lg)], e.g. components/templates/sections/HeroSection.tsx:74/96/218. This is DISTINCT from the Tailwind/shadcn --radius-sm..4xl scale defined in the @theme inline block (app/globals.css:48-54), which derives from a single --radius: 0.5rem (app/globals.css:58) via calc() and powers the generic rounded-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/3xl/4xl utilities used elsewhere (e.g. shadcn primitives). The two scales overlap in purpose but are not the same tokens.

base-shadcn.$description: --radius — app/globals.css:58 (0.5rem). Base value that Tailwind's rounded-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/3xl/4xl utilities derive from via calc(), per app/globals.css:48-54. Not part of the enforced --r-* scale above.

elevation.$description: app/globals.css :root, lines 100-101: 'exactly two elevations.' Applied inline as style={{ boxShadow: 'var(--e-raised)' }}, e.g. components/templates/sections/HeroSection.tsx:97.

fontFamily.$description: lib/fonts.ts (as of commit 4116d50), all loaded via next/font/google with display:'swap'. Every variable is applied to <html> via allFontVariables (lib/fonts.ts:52-59, consumed at app/layout.tsx:52) — none are loaded per-component. body/mono are shared across the whole app (marketing, dashboard, admin, shop, AND all 3 profile templates); display is SigmaTap's own marketing/legal heading face; the last three are per-template display faces used ONLY inside a rendered profile (components/templates/theme.ts fontVars).

display.$description: --font-display, Fraunces (variable font, axes SOFT/WONK/opsz) — lib/fonts.ts:11-16. Used on the marketing landing page and legal pages, e.g. app/page.tsx:108,411 and components/legal/LegalPage.tsx:56,63. NOT used by any profile template.

body.$description: --font-body, Geist — lib/fonts.ts:19-23. Mapped to Tailwind's --font-sans in app/globals.css:16 ('Serif is banned on dashboard surfaces' — lib/fonts.ts:18). Also the body face inside all 3 profile templates (components/templates/theme.ts fontVars.body is '--font-body' for editorial/kinetic/architectural alike, lines 61/84/107) — only each template's DISPLAY/heading face changes, not its body face.

mono.$description: --font-mono, Geist Mono — lib/fonts.ts:25-29. Not remapped in the @theme inline block, but Tailwind v4's own default theme token is also named --font-mono (node_modules/tailwindcss/theme.css:6), so the Geist Mono custom property is picked up by the plain `font-mono` utility automatically — confirmed empirically on the live site (a font-mono span computed to "Geist Mono", "Geist Mono Fallback"). Used across admin/shop tables for order numbers, SKUs and codes, e.g. app/admin/shop/orders/page.tsx, app/dashboard/cards/page.tsx.

tpl-editorial.$description: --font-tpl-editorial, Newsreader — lib/fonts.ts:33-37. Editorial template's display/heading face (components/templates/theme.ts:61). Also reused as Tailwind's --font-serif app-wide (app/globals.css:17), so `font-serif` anywhere in the app resolves to this face.

tpl-kinetic.$description: --font-tpl-kinetic, Space Grotesk — lib/fonts.ts:39-43. Kinetic template's display/heading face (components/templates/theme.ts:84).

tpl-architectural.$description: --font-tpl-architectural, Manrope — lib/fonts.ts:45-49. Architectural template's display/heading face (components/templates/theme.ts:107).

fontSize.$description: UNVERIFIED as a codebase-authored scale: app/globals.css has no --text-* overrides and the repo has no tailwind.config.*, so every text-* utility (text-xs..text-9xl) resolves to Tailwind v4's own default scale, confirmed by reading node_modules/tailwindcss/theme.css:299-324 directly (this is Tailwind's shipped default, not a SigmaTap-authored token — recorded here only because component code consistently uses these utility classes, e.g. HeroSection.tsx's text-4xl/text-5xl/text-2xl name treatments).

spacing.$description: app/globals.css has no --spacing override, so the app uses Tailwind v4's default single-value spacing scale (node_modules/tailwindcss/theme.css:277) — every p-*/m-*/gap-* utility is a multiple of this base unit. Not a SigmaTap-specific token; recorded for completeness.
